analysis_rules: Four virtual departure demands, not four independent observed passenger journeys.
Baseline query state must use only responses received at or before that departure.
Dynamic decisions may use only responses already received at the decision time.
Monitored=false and Monitored=true are analyzed separately.
Unmatched vehicles, missing data and journeys extending past capture are unknown.
15-minute demand spacing is not an assumed bus headway.
No Google calls, extra authentication probes, automatic retries or additional windows.
